report: Stage 4/5 - Feature engineering and time-series preparation
selection_rule: Top 500 products by number of days with sales (ties: units sold).

lag_1.description: Units sold on the previous calendar day (D-1). 0 if the shop was closed.

lag_7.description: Units sold 7 days earlier (same weekday last week).

last_open_day_demand.description: Units sold on the most recent day the shop was open before D (handles Sunday after a closed Saturday).

prev_day_open.description: 1 if the shop was open on D-1, else 0.

rolling_mean_7.description: Mean daily units over D-7..D-1 (shift(1) then rolling 7).

rolling_std_7.description: Standard deviation of daily units over D-7..D-1 (recent volatility).

rolling_max_7.description: Largest daily units over D-7..D-1 (recent bulk orders).

is_weekend.description: 1 if D is Saturday or Sunday.

is_month_start.description: 1 if D is the first day of a month.

is_month_end.description: 1 if D is the last day of a month.

last_known_price.description: Most recent average selling price observed BEFORE D (held constant into the future at forecast time).

avg_price_28.description: Average daily selling price over sale days in D-28..D-1 (the 'average daily price' feature, using only past prices).

price_change_pct.description: % difference between the last known price and the 28-day average price (recent price change).

sales_frequency.description: Share of days in the product's history up to D-1 that had a sale (how regularly it sells).

days_since_prev_sale.description: Calendar days between D and the most recent sale before D.

hist_mean_demand.description: Average daily units over the product's whole history up to D-1.

hist_std_demand.description: Standard deviation of daily units over the product's history up to D-1 (demand variability).

product_age_days.description: Days since the product's first sale.

assumptions: Observation window per product = first sale date to last sale date; no rows outside it.
Inside the window, a day without a sale is 0 demand.
Closed days (no sale anywhere in the shop) stay in the series as 0 but are not training rows.
Rows need at least 28 days of product history so every lag exists.
Prices: only past prices are used; the last known price is held constant when forecasting.
